root.label: UK announces intention to ban Palestine Action

events.label: UK announces intention to ban Palestine Action

slots.name: funds raised
slots.sentence: When the then home secretary, Yvette Cooper, announced her intention to ban Palestine Action under UK law in June last year, placing the group alongside the likes of Islamic State and Boko Haram, a CrowdJustice fundraiser for legal fees to fund a high court challenge raised more than £300,000 within days.
